title: TK Elevator MULTI
text:
TK Elevator MULTI

MULTI is a cable-less elevator developed by TK Elevator (formerly ThyssenKrupp Elevator). Rather than using cables to lift the elevator, MULTI uses linear motors built onto the cabin, the first of its kind. [1] As well as moving vertically between floors of a building, MULTI can also move horizontally through a floor of a building. MULTI is being tested at Rottweil Test Tower. [2] [3] 

## History

The system was installed inside a test tower in 2017. [4] As of 2024, there are no installations outside of testing sites. [citation needed]
